snippet.title: Barnburners - Arcade Hockey Official Gameplay Trailer | Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist Barnburners on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4842990/Barnburners/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=nextfest_wishlist_2026&utm_content=gameplay_trailer_description

Barnburners brings fast, hard-hitting arcade hockey to the ice. Throw big checks, bury goals, and settle rivalries with line brawls.
Get a look at different teams and arenas, outdoor hockey, and Franchise mode, where you can lead your club through an 82-game season and chase a championship.
Coming to Steam Early Access December 8, 2026.

Music: “Hackers” by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
https://karlcasey.bandcamp.com/track/hackers
#Barnburners #ArcadeHockey #IndieGames
